correctness.rationale: Both marginal means are 1/n. An incident joint event forces two specified fixed points. A nonincident fixed point leaves n−2 consecutive ordered value pairs if its label is an endpoint and n−3 otherwise, from (n−1)(n−2) ordered pairs. This proves every entry. After scaling, a left-null vector must sum to zero by an endpoint column, and two successive coefficients sum to zero by each interior column. The resulting alternating vector is possible exactly for odd n. The endpoint columns agree, the interior column totals give the stated aggregate, and n=2 follows directly from the identity and transposition. Independent exact-rational enumeration reproduced the entries, cancellations, totals and ranks for n=2,…,8, and separate scaled ranks for n=3,…,40. The frozen script was inspected, not executed. Finite checks corroborate the all-n counting argument.
